subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit: a fast tracking shot along sunlit flat concrete rooftops in a dense city, with air-conditioning units, a black water tank, satellite dishes, and brick apartment buildings in the background.
<Subject 1> is the parkour runner in <Video 1>, whose full movement is the reference for the target performance: sprinting across the rooftop, planting a hand on the low railing and vaulting over it, running on, leaping down to the next, lower rooftop, landing, rolling forward, and springing back up into a run.
<Subject 2> is the young man in <Picture 1>, with deep brown skin, closely cropped black hair, a light goatee, an oversized deep red quilted puffer jacket with a tall stand-up collar, black snap buttons, and two flap pockets, a light blue button-up shirt, a cream ribbed turtleneck, loose black wide-leg trousers, and black leather shoes.
<Subject 3> is the rooftop environment in <Video 1>, including the concrete roofs, the low railing, the air-conditioning units, the black water tank, the satellite dishes, the city skyline, and the hazy sunlit sky.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The camera, framing, timing, and <Subject 3> are kept, and the runner is replaced by <Subject 2>, who performs the exact movement of <Subject 1>: the sprint, the railing vault, the leap down to the next rooftop, the forward roll, and the return to running.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (camera, framing, and timing): fully_preserved - the tracking camera movement, framing, shake, and timing of every action are kept.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - the running, vaulting, leaping, rolling, and recovery movements transfer to <Subject 2>.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the face, skin tone, cropped hair, goatee, deep red puffer jacket, light blue shirt, cream turtleneck, black trousers, and black leather shoes are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the rooftops, railing, air-conditioning units, water tank, satellite dishes, skyline, and lighting are kept unchanged.

detailed_description:
The target video keeps the live-action, cinematic look of <Video 1>, with bright, hazy late-morning sunlight and long shadows across the rooftops.
[Shot 1] The tracking shot of <Video 1> follows the runner across <Subject 3> from the right side at the same speed and framing. The runner is now <Subject 2>, the young man with deep brown skin, closely cropped black hair, and a light goatee, wearing the oversized deep red quilted puffer jacket with its tall collar standing up, the light blue shirt hem showing below it, the cream turtleneck at his neck, loose black wide-leg trousers, and black leather shoes. He sprints across the concrete roof past the air-conditioning units, his puffer jacket bouncing with each stride and his trousers flapping around his ankles. He plants one bare hand on the low railing and vaults sideways over it, swinging his legs across, then lands and keeps running past the black water tank. At the edge of the roof, he leaps out and drops down onto the next, lower rooftop, his arms thrown forward and the jacket billowing open. He lands, tucks into a forward roll across the roof, the red jacket crumpling against the concrete, and springs back up into a run toward the satellite dishes, matching every movement and timing of <Subject 1>. The camera keeps the same slight shake on his landing as in <Video 1>.

overall_soundscape:
Quick footsteps of leather soles pound on the concrete, his palm smacks the metal railing as he vaults, and the puffer jacket rustles with every stride. Wind rushes past during the leap, followed by a heavy thud on landing, the scrape of nylon fabric during the roll, and his sharp breathing as he runs on over distant city traffic.

non_diegetic_music:
A driving electronic beat at a fast tempo with a pulsing synth bass, briefly dropping out mid-leap and slamming back in on his landing.
